summary.text: Craig Richardson is a Republican member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 3, serving since 2025. The legislature's profile lists Richardson as vice chair of the Senate Health Services Committee and co-chair of its Budget Review Subcommittee on Health & Family Services.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Craig Richardson was born on September 28, 1984, and is an attorney.
The profile lists a B.S. from the University of Kentucky and a J.D. from the University of Memphis.
